backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining types and storage for sessions, context switches, breaks, achievements, and reports with functions to record user activity and generate behavioral reports.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping implemented features to source files, components, and test IDs, covering app categorization, live monitoring, burnout warnings, blocking, breaks, achievements, and reports.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of frontend TypeScript/React files describing pages, components, and hooks for productivity monitoring, burnout detection, breaks, achievements, and reports.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and script tag loading the React application from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component configuring TanStack Router with routes for dashboard, monitoring, categorization, breaks, achievements, and reports, plus global overlays for burnout warnings, greyscale filter, and blocking screens.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsBadg: React component rendering an individual achievement badge with image, title, description, unlock status, and optional progress bar.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsGall: React component displaying a grid of achievement badges with share and export functionality, showing unlock progress statistics.
frontend/src/components/BlockScreen.tsx: Full-screen modal component that blocks access during a 25-minute focus session, displaying a countdown timer, progress bar, and productivity tips.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutWarning.t: Animated toast notification that appears when burnout index is high, prompting users to take a desk recovery break with dismissible actions.
frontend/src/components/DailyRecommendat: Card component that displays a numbered list of personalized daily recommendations to improve user focus.
frontend/src/components/GreyscaleOverlay: Full-screen overlay that applies a grayscale filter with variable intensity to reduce visual stimulation and distractions.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout with sticky header navigation, quick action buttons for breaks, and footer with branding and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/MetricsCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying a single metric with title, value, icon, and optional trend indicator.
frontend/src/components/PatternCard.tsx: Card component that displays behavioral patterns with positive or negative styling, including title, description, and trend information.
frontend/src/components/PeriodicReport.t: Report view component with time period selector that displays positive patterns and areas for improvement using PatternCard components, with export functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProductivityScor: Card component displaying an overall productivity score with circular progress visualization, color-coded rating, and contextual feedback message.
frontend/src/components/RecoveryQualityC: Card component with pie chart visualization showing the breakdown of restorative vs non-restorative break time using Recharts.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: Custom hook that manages achievement data including unlocked status, progress tracking, and share functionality for gamification features.
Simulates random application switching behavior for demo purposes, randomly selecting apps every 8 seconds and recording switches to the backend actor while tracking switch counts and rates.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useApplications.ts: Manages a list of applications categorized as productive or distracting, persisting them to localStorage with CRUD operations (add, update, remove).
frontend/src/hooks/useBlockingLogic.ts: Implements blocking logic that triggers a 25-minute block period after 2 warnings, with a countdown timer that resets upon completion of a productive session.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakAnalytics.ts: Provides hardcoded break analytics data showing restorative vs non-restorative time percentages (45 minutes restorative, 15 minutes non-restorative).
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakTimer.ts: Manages a break timer for desk recovery or walk breaks, tracking duration and recording completed breaks to the backend actor with start/end timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreathingAnimation: Controls a breathing animation cycle with four phases (inhale, hold, exhale, rest) that adjusts scale values over a 16-second cycle when active.
frontend/src/hooks/useBurnoutMonitor.ts: Monitors and simulates burnout index that gradually increases over time, categorizing burnout levels (0-2) with dismissible warnings at thresholds of 4 and 7.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardData.ts: Provides mock dashboard data including focus/distraction times, switching frequency, productivity score, weekly burnout trends, and personalized recommendations.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusTimer.ts: Tracks focus session duration in seconds when active, providing formatted time display in MM:SS format.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing identity state and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a React Query hook to fetch all reports from the backend actor, enabled only when the actor is available and not fetching.
frontend/src/hooks/useReportData.ts: Provides mock report data with positive and negative work patterns, including descriptions and trends, with simulated loading state based on selected time period.
frontend/src/hooks/useWalkBreakTimer.ts: Manages a configurable walk break timer with start/pause/reset controls, plays an alert sound on completion, and records break data to the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, supportive color palette for light and dark themes, including primary, secondary, accent, and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/copyConstants.ts: Centralized copy/text constants for the application including app name, dashboard messages, warning thresholds, blocking tips, and break activity benefits.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Page component displaying user achievements and productivity milestones using the AchievementsGallery component.
frontend/src/pages/AppCategorization.tsx: Page for managing application categories (productive vs. distracting) with add, edit, and delete functionality using the useApplications hook.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying productivity metrics, burnout trends, focus/distraction time, switching frequency, and daily recommendations with charts and cards.
frontend/src/pages/DeskRecovery.tsx: Guided breathing exercise page with animated breathing circle, timer controls, and step-by-step instructions for desk recovery breaks.
frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx: Real-time activity monitoring page showing current application, focus duration, and context-switching metrics using simulated activity data.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Behavioral reports page displaying periodic productivity patterns and habits using the PeriodicReport component.
frontend/src/pages/WalkBreak.tsx: React component for a walk break timer page with configurable duration (5-60 minutes), start/pause/reset controls, progress visualization, and tips for effective breaks.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript type definitions for Application (with productive/distracting categories), ContextSwitch, and FocusSession data structures.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, extended theme settings including border radius, shadows, animations, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a privacy-first productivity monitoring application with context switching detection, burnout tracking, progressive interventions, and break quality algorithms.
